node: AI data-center power chain: electrical equipment, cooling, grid interconnection and construction services
summary: Layer 1B expansion found four US-listed underfollowed or second-order candidates tied to AI data-center power/cooling/construction constraints. The strongest direct evidence is Powell Industries for medium-voltage electrical equipment and IES Holdings for electrical/technology installation and custom infrastructure, both citing data-center demand and sharply higher backlog. Modine is a more visible but still non-mega-cap thermal-management candidate with direct hyperscale/colocation cooling exposure and capacity expansion. AZZ is a weaker second-order hypothesis: it is not a data-center equipment supplier, but its galvanizing/coatings role may become relevant where data-center buildouts require protected steel infrastructure, substations, racks, supports, fencing, and related outdoor electrical/construction assets. No buy/sell recommendation is implied; this is a research universe expansion only.
